column3: “Established” is rendered “set up,” and “foundations” as “foundation.” “Terror was on them” is rendered “they were terrified.”
NASB supplies “offered”; “the matter of a day in its day” is rendered “as each day required.”
“A burnt offering of continuity” is rendered “a continual burnt offering”; NASB supplies “there was.”
“The temple was not founded” is rendered “the foundation of the temple … had not been laid.”
“As one” is rendered “united,” and “the doer of the work on the house” as “the workmen in the temple.” NASB reorders the names.
The Hebrew reads “they stationed the priests”; NASB has “the priests stood.” “Fully clothed” is rendered “in their apparel,” and “on the hands of David” as “according to the directions of … David.”
NASB supplies “before”; “to lift up a voice” is rendered “shouted aloud.”
